oral administration of the B. thermophilus extract to chickens resulted in a reduction in E. coli numbers and an improvement in the survival of the treated chickens.

oral administration of the enzyme-digsted B. thermophilium extract sample significantly improved the survival rate and proliferation activity of concanavalin A–stiumlated lymphocytes of chickens infected with E. coli.

the effect of oral administration of Bifidum thermophilum extract on the resistance of chicken against E. coli infections.
